observations: Photo 0: Piles of used car tyres on a concrete floor; several tyres are stacked upright and some are laid on their sides with visible tread and sidewall wear.
Photo 1: More stacks of used tyres; several tyres are placed in the foreground with open rims/holes visible; background shows additional tyre stacks and some wheel rims on the left.
Photo 2: Tyres stacked in columns; a few tyres are laid flat in front; tread patterns and sidewall markings are visible but not clearly readable.
